why: The rules and guards that steer the agent stay as they are or shrink, never grow: a cut held by text alone grew back within days, twice. tests/structure.test.mjs adds up the characters of what is listed in count (line ends as LF) and fails over limit, or when a cut leaves more than slack under it, so the limit comes down with every cut. '@WORKFLOW.md' means the files WORKFLOW.md names for explicit reading; a name ending in / means every file under it.
